rationale: Ride-through check: The resource remains connected throughout the event trace. All voltage/time points are inside the ride-through envelope (V=0.55pu at t=0.05s and t=0.12s exceeds the 0.2pu and 0.5pu minimums respectively for those durations). Reactive current check: Voltage drops below 0.9pu at t=0.05s, and by the response deadline of t=0.15s, iq reaches 0.25pu at t=0.12s, meeting the 0.2pu minimum requirement. At t=0.55s, voltage recovers to 0.9pu, so reactive current requirement no longer applies.
